parts.name: Prophecy
parts.desc: After you send the first monster from your hand to your deck each turn, give it _Rush_.

parts.name: Rush  (Keyword)
parts.desc: If this is the first non-TOKEN monster you have drawn this turn, it has -1 cost until the end of the turn.

parts.name: Scarf Lady
parts.desc: Magic: Look at all Turbo and _Rush_ monsters in your deck and choose one. Add it to the top of your deck with -1 cost.

parts.name: Clover Head
parts.desc: Magic: Choose a non-DT monster with Turbo or _Rush_ in your hand. Add a copy of it to the top of your deck.

parts.name: Cash Register
parts.desc: Magic: Choose a card in your hand to send to your deck and draw a card. If it had Turbo or _Rush_, draw 2 cards instead.

parts.name: Umbrella Monster
parts.desc: Whenever you draw a Turbo or _Rush_ monster, give it -1 cost.

parts.name: Dapper Charles
parts.desc: _Rush_. Turbo: Give the top monster in your deck _Rush_. If it already has _Rush_, give it +1/+2 instead.

parts.name: TV
parts.desc: Turbo: Add the same random monster to the top of both players' decks. Give yours -1 cost and _Rush_.

parts.name: Devil Doll
parts.desc: _Rush_. Turbo: Deal 1 DMG to a random enemy monster. Magic: Deal 2 DMG to all damaged enemy monsters.

parts.name: Ice Wolf
parts.desc: Turbo: Gain +1 HP. Dust: Summon an {Ice} for the opponent.
